search.region: Toronto + inner GTA (East York, Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke, York)
search.also_consider: 2-unit homes ONLY if a 3rd unit (e.g. garden suite / basement) is already roughed-in or permitted
good_location_signals: walking distance to TTC subway/streetcar or GO station
low neighbourhood vacancy (CMHC Toronto vacancy is ~2%)
near hospitals, universities/colleges, or major employment
avoid: major road frontage only if price compensates, severe deferred maintenance

financing.rate_note: Update each run: search current best 5-yr fixed INSURED mortgage rate Canada
